title: Issue-linked derivative periodicity witness for DeepXDE PeriodicBC

source_case_schema.source_function: smooth scalar u(x) on [0,1] with endpoint values and endpoint derivatives available

parameters.derivative_order: 0 for value periodicity, 1 for first-derivative periodicity

transformation_preconditions: The target boundary condition is periodic on a smooth function over [0,1].
The PDE or issue context requires first-derivative periodicity in addition to value periodicity.
Endpoint values and first derivatives can be evaluated analytically.
The external issue and merged PR document the PeriodicBC derivative-order semantic change.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: DeepXDE issue #26 discusses cases where value-only periodicity is insufficient for the reported PDE boundary semantics, and PR #27 adds derivative_order support to PeriodicBC.

output_mapping.description: Pair x=0 with x=1 and compare either u(0)-u(1) or du/dx(0)-du/dx(1), matching DeepXDE PR #27's derivative_order branch.

metric.name: periodic_boundary_derivative_residual
metric.formula: abs(du/dx(0) - du/dx(1)) for derivative_order=1; contrast with abs(u(0)-u(1)) for derivative_order=0

exclusion_rules: Exclude nonsmooth functions whose first derivative is undefined at either periodic endpoint.
Exclude PDE contexts that require value periodicity only and do not require derivative periodicity.
Exclude any claim that the witness is a trained-surrogate accuracy result.
Exclude any broad defect-rate claim beyond this one external issue/PR-linked witness.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The issue/PR artifacts are present and the semantic source/follow-up residual checks reproduce the value-only blind spot and derivative-order witness.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The artifact checks or residual checks contradict the expected issue-linked semantic contrast.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because source artifacts were unavailable.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The function or PDE context does not require first-derivative periodicity.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: Endpoint evaluation uncertainty dominates the analytic residual.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The external issue/PR link or semantic residual evidence is incomplete.

claim_limitations: This MR card supports one external issue/PR-linked boundary-condition semantic witness for a SciML library component. It does not report a trained-SUT verdict, a real-world defect-detection rate, DeepXDE-wide correctness, PINN accuracy, or production CFD readiness.
